name: Python (basic)
description: Fundamental programming syntax, variables, data structures (lists, dicts, sets), control flow, and functions in Python.

name: Python (advanced)
description: Object-oriented programming, decorators, generators, context managers, concurrency (asyncio, threading), and type hinting in Python.

name: HTML
description: Semantic HTML5 markup, web accessibility (a11y), DOM structure, and forms.

name: CSS
description: CSS3 styling, Flexbox, CSS Grid layouts, responsive design, animations, and CSS variables.

name: JavaScript
description: Modern ECMAScript (ES6+), closures, promises, async/await, DOM manipulation, and event-driven architecture.

name: TypeScript
description: Static typing for JavaScript, interfaces, generics, type guards, and modern TypeScript configuration.

name: React
description: Component-based UI development, hooks (useState, useEffect, useMemo), state management, and virtual DOM.

name: Next.js
description: Server-side rendering (SSR), static site generation (SSG), React Server Components, App Router, and full-stack React framework.

name: Node.js
description: Node.js event loop, runtime asynchronous I/O, file system operations, and npm package management.

name: FastAPI
description: High-performance Python web framework, Pydantic data validation, OpenAPI autodocs, and asynchronous route handling.

name: REST APIs
description: RESTful API design principles, HTTP verbs, status codes, request/response headers, pagination, and JSON serialization.

name: GraphQL
description: GraphQL schema design, queries, mutations, resolvers, and Apollo/GraphQL clients.

name: SQL & Relational Databases
description: Relational database modeling, complex SQL queries, JOINs, indexing, normalization, transactions, and ACID properties.

name: PostgreSQL
description: Advanced PostgreSQL features, jsonb columns, full-text search, query optimization, EXPLAIN plans, and connection pooling.

name: MongoDB & NoSQL
description: Document-oriented NoSQL database design, BSON format, aggregation pipelines, and indexing in MongoDB.

name: ORMs & Query Builders
description: Object Relational Mapping with SQLAlchemy, Prisma, or TypeORM, migrations, entity relationships, and query performance.

name: Authentication & JWT
description: User authentication, JWT token lifecycle, OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect, session management, password hashing (bcrypt), and RBAC authorization.

name: Git & GitHub
description: Version control workflows, branching strategies, merge conflicts, rebase, pull requests, and collaborative code reviews.

name: Docker & Containers
description: Containerization fundamentals, writing Dockerfiles, multi-stage builds, Docker Compose for multi-container orchestration, and image optimization.

name: CI/CD Pipelines
description: Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment with GitHub Actions, automated test pipelines, and automated artifact deployment.

name: Linux & Bash Scripting
description: Linux shell navigation, command line tools, permission management, cron jobs, process management, and shell automation scripts.

name: Redis & Caching
description: In-memory key-value data storage, caching strategies (cache-aside, write-through), rate limiting, pub/sub messaging, and TTL management.

name: Message Queues & Asynchronous Tasks
description: Asynchronous task processing, message brokers with RabbitMQ or Celery, event-driven decoupling, and dead-letter queues.

name: Unit & Integration Testing
description: Automated test suites with pytest or Jest, test doubles/mocks, fixtures, integration testing, and test coverage metrics.

name: System Design & Architecture
description: Scalable web architecture, load balancing, horizontal scaling, database sharding/replication, CAP theorem, and microservices patterns.

name: Cloud Basics (AWS / GCP)
description: Core cloud infrastructure, compute instances (EC2/GCE), serverless functions, object storage (S3/GCS), and VPC networking.

name: Web Security & OWASP
description: Web vulnerability mitigation (OWASP Top 10), prevention of XSS, CSRF, SQL Injection, CORS configuration, and HTTPS/TLS encryption.

name: Data Structures & Algorithms
description: Time/space complexity (Big-O), arrays, hash maps, trees, graphs, dynamic programming, sorting, and algorithmic problem solving.

name: Microservices & API Gateway
description: Service decomposition, API gateway routing, service discovery, inter-service communication (gRPC, REST), and distributed tracing.

name: Data Analysis & Pandas
description: Data manipulation with Pandas, numerical computing with NumPy, data cleaning, exploratory data analysis, and tabular feature engineering.

name: Machine Learning Fundamentals
description: Supervised & unsupervised learning, regression, classification, scikit-learn, cross-validation, model evaluation metrics, and overfitting prevention.

name: Deep Learning & PyTorch
description: Neural networks, backpropagation, PyTorch/TensorFlow models, GPU acceleration, transformers, and model inference optimization.

name: Kubernetes & Orchestration
description: Container orchestration at scale, Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress controllers, Helm charts, and cluster auto-scaling.

name: Monitoring & Observability
description: Application logging, metrics collection (Prometheus, Grafana), health checks, alerting, and error tracking (Sentry).

name: LLM Applications & RAG Systems
description: Building AI applications with Large Language Models, prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), LangChain/LlamaIndex, and AI agents.

name: Vector Databases & Embeddings
description: Dense vector representations, similarity search algorithms, vector store databases (Chroma, Pinecone, FAISS), and hybrid search retrieval.
